title: Changizi on the Last Samurai Syndrome
author: Mark Changizi

metaphors.title: Last Samurai Syndrome
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematicians who spent their lives mastering hard riddles are like samurai facing the firearm in the hands of an untrained soldier: AI nullifies the tactical advantage of decades; true for math, he suspects, less so for seminal breakthroughs in science.
metaphors.style_hint: A lone samurai in armour facing a row of musketeers.
metaphors.district_reason: A warrior caste made obsolete by firearms: a battlefield image of skill overturned by a new weapon.
